_about: The studio's path to every licence and terms page it relies on for AI-generated content: the page, the exact clause, its date, and R&D's verdict per use. Uses: assets (shipping output commercially), training (output as training data), evaluation (output in tests or controls), code (AI-written code in studio tools). Verdicts: proven, conditions (proven with the conditions listed), barred, not_proven, n/a. snapshot_sha256 is the sha256 of the page text as fetched on read_date; full-text snapshots are kept off the repo (see README). This is a reading of published terms, not legal advice.

clauses: using AI-generated content from our services to develop machine learning models or related AI technology

Revised 2026-10-17: code is read by the clause's purpose (stopping extraction into a rival model), so studio code that no model trains on is allowed, AI tooling included; training data stays barred.
conditions: Code: allowed when no model trains on it and it builds no rival to Google; training data, and text a model trains on, stay barred
